pm_structure.summary: General account managed by Addenda Capital Inc., the group's wholly owned asset manager (acquired 2008), on arm's-length fees 'consistent with external clients'; sustainable-investing policy applies to all assets; Management Investment Committee under Board Risk Committee oversight.
manager_entities: Addenda Capital Inc. (Montreal; wholly owned by Co-operators since 2008; founded 1996; C$42.5bn AUM; 170+ staff)
Co-operators Financial Investment Services (CFIS) - mutual fund dealer
bullets: CGIC AFR: 'The majority of Co-operators General's investment portfolio is managed by Addenda'; Addenda fee to CGIC C$8.1mm in 2025 (7.5 in 2024) 'consistent with Addenda's external clients'; annual contract.
IAR: 'Through our asset management company Addenda Capital Inc. Co-operators manages over $42.5 billion in assets' (incl. CLIC, CGIC and third-party clients).
Addenda asset classes: fixed income, equities, commercial mortgages (EVP Adam Kot), multi-asset; mortgages rated with Addenda's internal rating system.
Board Risk Committee oversees the sustainable investment strategy 'managed by the Management Investment Committee'.
Co-operators debt financing (mortgages and private commercial loans) authorised 2025: 80 loans, C$270.6mm.
Addenda board includes Rob Wesseling and Karen Higgins; Chair Michael J. White.

rotation_commentary.text: 2030 Impact and Climate Investing Roadmap: 60% of invested assets in impact/climate-transition investments by 2030 (interim 50% by 2026); already C$8.75bn or 60.2% of group invested assets.
Climate solutions target US$3bn by 2030 from US$2bn base (2024); financed-emissions intensity -40% by 2029 (vs 2020); net zero portfolio by 2050 (NZAOA).

Group mix: bonds 63.8% (97.7% investment grade; AAA 21.6/AA 30.6/A 27.9/BBB 17.6/below 2.3), stocks 15.2% (Canadian preferreds 31.6% of stocks), mortgages 8.5% (5-yr loss ratio 0.62%), short-term 1.0%, other 11.5%.
Invested assets +8.7%; bonds reinvested at higher yields as book grows and matures; steeper curve produced unrealised bond gains; strong common/preferred equity gains.
CLIC Tier 2 capital +27% to 422.2 while LICAT fell to 160% under the 2025 guideline's seg-fund guarantee standard approach.

target_allocations.target: 60% of invested assets by YE2030; 50% by YE2026

target_allocations.asset_class: Financed emissions intensity (listed equity & corporate bonds)

deals.text: Co-operators acquires Addenda Capital (founded 1996) and merges in Co-operators Investment Counselling; Addenda becomes group asset manager.
Alec Blundell named EVP & COO Co-operators Life and President & COO CUMIS (Mar 2019).
One-time acquisition in life operations (unnamed) lifted 2024 premiums and deposits; 2025 growth 4.3% ex-acquisition.
Launch of Co-operators Financial Investment Services (mutual fund dealer); AUA C$2.33bn by end-2025 from C$20mm.

sponsorships.text: Naming rights to 'The Co-operators Centre' arena complex at Evraz Place, Regina (10-year, C$1.3mm) - dated; renewal status unknown.
Community contributions 4.05% of pre-tax income (target 4-4.5%); Imagine Canada Caring Company; Prosper Canada financial-hardship report funded.

bank_relationships.text: CUMIS (owned by Co-operators) distributes creditor, travel and other insurance through Canadian credit unions and caisses populaires - the group's bancassurance-style channel.
Minority interest in Aviso Wealth LP (credit-union wealth platform).
Structured settlements placed with life insurers rated A or higher (CGIC guarantees C$656.6mm).

appetite: Risk appetite 'defines the types and amount of risk we are willing and able to responsibly accept'; describes risks avoided, assumed and limits (IAR).
Risk-based capital targets set with 'sophisticated modelling'; capital plans evaluated annually against risk profile.
Top 2025 risks: geopolitical, extreme weather/climate, cyber, future of work, shifting client preferences.
governance: Board Risk Committee oversees ERM program, risk appetite, CRO and sustainable investment strategy (via Management Investment Committee).
ERM team identifies, assesses, quantifies (stress and sensitivity testing) and reports to Board Risk Committee, management and regulators.
Audit and Finance Committee oversees financial reporting incl. climate disclosures; OSFI thematic reviews on non-financial risk in 2025.
risk.capital_target: Internal risk-based capital targets not quantified. CLIC LICAT 160% total / 119% core (Dec 31, 2025) vs OSFI supervisory 100% / 70%.
sensitivities: None published for CLIC (group IAR and CGIC AFR carry P&C sensitivities only).
hedging: FX derivatives notional 189.6 (OSFI LF3); seg-fund guarantee risk now under LICAT standard approach - no dynamic hedging program disclosed.
events: LICAT 2025 guideline cut CLIC ratios (168% to 160% total; 130% to 119% core).
Life ROE 9.5% below 13-17% target; life expense ratio above target (2025).
OSFI thematic reviews on non-financial risk (2025).

gaps: Co-operative: no proxy circular; no executive compensation disclosed for any officer.
CLIC publishes no standalone financial statements, sensitivities or business-mix split; entity figures come from OSFI LF1 and the LICAT disclosure.
Group CRO not named publicly; no 'President' title for CLIC (Blundell is EVP & COO).
Addenda CEO/CIO start dates rely partly on aggregators (MarketScreener, Form ADV); Addenda bio pages returned 404.
Current AM Best rating for CLIC taken from a Dec 2021 release; cooperators.ca ratings page 404'd and web search budget was exhausted before a 2025/26 affirmation was found.
No sponsorship announcements found for 2024-26 beyond community contributions; the Regina arena naming is from 2009.
companies.csv lists CLIC as a subsidiary of CGIC; CGIC's AFR describes CLIC as an affiliate 'under common control' via CFSL/CGL - repo metadata may need correcting.
notes: Group (CGL) figures are dominated by P&C (insurance revenue 6,908; NI 695.3). CLIC is roughly 38% of group invested assets and holds all seg funds. CGIC's 2025 annual financial report is the P&C entity's and was used only for group structure, Addenda fees, ratings framework and governance.
